name: event
description: One line of activity: who did what to which thing, and when. Used for change receipts under a reply and for the activity log.

action.description: Past-tense verb: added, updated, removed, cleared, said, failed.

target.description: What was acted on, such as 'table' or 'list Groceries'.

detail.description: Optional extra text shown after the target.

wcag.notes: The actor is spelled out ('You', 'Assistant', 'System'), so provenance never depends on colour. Render events inside a list so counts and positions are announced.

machine.identify: Read data-actor, data-action, and data-target; the text is the sentence.
